subject.title: docs: changelog for Slack Desktop v16 cache decoding

question: Should the Unreleased release note for the merged Slack Desktop cache-decoding fix include this contributor credit?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow, but repository policy reserves changelog ownership to the release process and the PR author is a collaborator, so automation should not make the acceptance decision.

options.title: Accept the attribution
options.body: Merge the one-line credit if contributor acknowledgements belong in Unreleased release entries.

options.title: Keep release notes release-owned
options.body: Close or revise the PR if release-note attribution is handled elsewhere or only during release preparation.

recommendation.title: Accept the attribution
recommendation.body: Merge the one-line credit if contributor acknowledgements belong in Unreleased release entries.
